column1: # Per-function CALL-COUNT join, port vs C, on REAL CONTENT — 55 edges x 3 presets, one column per
# content: "<port_count>/<c_count>=<port/C ratio>" (no_c: C has 0 calls; both0: neither side).
# Read callcount_realimg_2026-09-04.meta first; per-cell identity/Ir in callcount_realimg_2026-09-04.cells.tsv.
#   valgrind-3.26.0 callgrind (Ir); rustc 1.98.1; gcc 15.2.0; C oracle reference/svt-av1 @ 3115c0c1
# cells: gradient = synthetic control | photo_cid = CID22-512 3571065.png 512x512 | photo_clic =
#   clic2025 1e2f9d41... Mitchell 512x512 | photo_clic500 = same source, 500x332 | screen_terminal =
#   gb82-sc terminal.png centre crop 512x512 | lineart_graph = gb82-sc graph.png centre crop 512x480.
# BYTE-IDENTITY: every cell Y EXCEPT screen_terminal p2 and lineart_graph p2 — those two columns at
#   preset 2 are counts on DIVERGENT encodes and are NOT ratios (marked with a trailing "!").
# METHOD: tools/perf_profile/callcount_cells.sh -> callcount.py (per-function totals from the raw
#   callgrind `calls=` edges) -> callcount_join.py --tsv (990-row long form with every matched symbol
#   listed per side and the port's inclusive Ir; 154 KB, NOT committed for size — regenerate from the
#   callgrind outputs with the same command, or ask for it) -> this pivot. Every regex may match
#   several symbols per side; counts are SUMMED, so a duplicate transcription cannot hide in a ratio.
